questions.prompt: A grid of 40 equal blocks, 16 SMs, 2 blocks resident per SM. Tail efficiency, in %?
Why is the tail effect worst for well-tuned GEMMs?
options: Big tiles mean few blocks, so a partial last wave is a large fraction of the work
questions.explanation: Few big blocks quantise badly onto the SMs.

questions.prompt: Blocks of very unequal work, dispatched in order of increasing work. What happens to the time?
options: The heaviest blocks start last, and one of them decides when the kernel ends
questions.explanation: Start heavy work first, or split it.

options: Smaller tiles (at some per-tile efficiency cost)
questions.explanation: All three make the work divide more evenly over the SMs.

options: One launched with about one block per SM that loops over work items itself
questions.explanation: The kernel, not the hardware, distributes the work.
